response.justification: Despite a strong and diverse software engineering background, the candidate lacks demonstrable professional C++ experience on Windows platforms and has no visible exposure to capital markets, fixed income, or investment banking domains — both mandatory requirements for this role. Their C++ exposure is limited to academic/bachelor’s thesis work and is not aligned with the financial systems context required.
strengths: Extensive full-stack experience across multiple languages and platforms
Strong DevOps and CI/CD practices demonstrated across roles
Proven ability to lead open-source projects and technical workshops
concerns: No professional C++ development experience on Windows platform
No evidence of fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domain exposure
SQL experience listed but not tied to SQL Server or Oracle in financial systems context
